technical.summary: Strong bullish technicals with multi-timeframe trend confirmation and breakout signals, but overbought conditions across multiple oscillators present pullback risk; neutral sector momentum limits tailwind.

fundamental.summary: EQT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 37 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for a bullish thesis.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market in fear zone (42/100) with bearish AAII sentiment (49.8%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (3+ years old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (416.16), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 37 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Three white soldiers + DC20 new high + EMA 50/200 bullish alignment provide strong technical confirmation of uptrend initiation with price near support (25.23) offering favorable risk/reward entry geometry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (RSI 9/14, Stoch, Williams %R) across all timeframes signal imminent pullback risk, compounded by zero fundamental support, severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising dollar), high earnings risk in 37 days, and price below both 50/200 EMAs negating the bullish narrative.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows three white soldiers and DC20 new high with bullish EMA alignment, but this is negated by overbought oscillators across all timeframes signaling imminent pullback risk.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis at 416.16, flat yield curve, rising dollar) combined with high earnings risk in 37 days and zero fundamental/smart money support create asymmetric downside risk despite technical strength.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical bullish signals overwhelmed by fundamental weakness, macro crisis conditions, and overbought technicals; all agents converge on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already 8 positions open in Energy sector; adding EQT would increase concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro crisis without conviction support.
